Name: Nebo in Judah
ModernLocation: Unknown; possibly Nuba, near Hebron, in Judah
Description: A town named in the lists of those who returned from exile with Zerubbabel, distinct from the Moabite town of Nebo east of the Jordan.
BiblicalSignificance: Nebo in Judah marks a home to which exiles returned, a small name in the record of restoration.
